screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.a: The live Attack Damage attribute after base value, equipment, effects, talents, Aegises, Skill Enhancements, and other mods.
The live Armor attribute after equipment, effects, Skill Enhancements, and other mods.
A percentage bonus applied to every eligible Skill Enhancement stat. Eligibility is configured separately for each enhancement in skill_enhancements.json.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.o: Base, accumulated, equipment, or external effects
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.b: The fixed strength of each Breakthrough. Base strength is 100%. Starlight's random double-or-triple effect is not included in this value.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.f: Current Final Damage bonus from accumulated effects, owned talents, active Soul Links, and conditional talent bonuses.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.d: General Damage Bonus shared by ordinary physical, magic, and skill damage calculations.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.a: An independent multiplier applied only to direct melee attacks, including Righteous Knight stacks and active Soul Links.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.m: Magic Damage applies when the actual damage type is tagged as magic. A spell independently receives Skill Damage whether its damage is physical or magic.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.p: Current physical damage amplification from talents, accumulated effects, and active Soul Links.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.m: Current magic damage amplification from talents, accumulated effects, and active Soul Links.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.s: Current Skill Damage bonus, including Skill Enhancements, accumulated gains, and talent scaling from Evasion, Lucky Strike, or owned talents. Iron's Spells receive this bonus.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.t: Current True Damage bonus from owned talents and accumulated Breakthrough effects.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.h: Percentage of maximum health restored per second by talent effects.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.m: Mana regeneration bonus from talents. Compatible mana mods apply percentage multipliers directly.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.h: Accumulated bonus applied to health restoration effects.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.s: Current Summon Power from accumulated effects and per-summon talent scaling.
Additional summons granted by talents and custom effects.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.c: Current effective Critical Chance. Uses the live Apothic Attributes value when that mod is installed.
Current effective Critical Damage, including Millennium Echo overflow when active.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.l: The live Luck attribute. Each 1 Luck contributes 10% Lucky Strike and also controls the number of perk choices.
Current Lucky Strike bonus. Total outgoing damage is multiplied by 1 + this value. It is capped at 300% unless an effect removes the cap.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.p: Permanent Primary Skill Enhancement ranks gained from talent triggers. Choose the target once; Matter-to-Magic Conversion unlocks free switching later.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.a: Additional entity reach accumulated from talents and summon scaling. This increases how far away your left-click melee attacks can hit entities.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.c: General Cooldown Reduction from owned talents. This will integrate with Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks later.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.a: The live Attack Speed attribute. Flat includes its base and additive bonuses, Percentage includes its effective multiplicative bonuses, and Final is the resulting attacks-per-second value.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.i: Accumulated Independent Skill Damage gained from Breakthrough effects.
Accumulated Independent Skill Area gained from Breakthrough effects.
Independent damage amplification from talents and accumulated Soul Link Breakthrough effects.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.d: Effective incoming Damage Reduction. The percentage value shows the uncapped accumulated amount; combat uses at most the server-configured positive cap. Negative values remain uncapped and increase damage taken.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.s: Current bonus to shields gained from talent effects.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.r: Saved revival charges currently available to this player.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.stat.t: Additional choices displayed whenever a new talent offer is rolled.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.toggle: Click this card to turn the talent on or off.
screen.aegis_ascension.collection.aegis_: Click this card to turn the Aegis effect on or off.

Bring the farmer the requested crop.

quest.aegis_ascension.side.fletcher_hunt: Hunt the creature troubling the village road.
Travelers have stopped using the eastern road. The fletcher asks you to remove the nearby threat.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.armorer_mater: Deliver materials for urgent armor repairs.
Several guards returned with shattered equipment, leaving the armorer short of workable material.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.librarian_tra: Trade in writing supplies for the village archive.
Rain leaked through the archive roof and ruined important records. The librarian is rebuilding the collection.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.weaponsmith_m: Deliver metal for a new village weapon.
The village watch has taken on new recruits, but the weaponsmith lacks enough metal to equip them.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.fisherman_cat: Bring the fisherman the requested catch.
Strong currents swept away the village nets, and the fisherman needs a fresh catch before the market opens.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.shepherd_wool: Deliver wool for the village blankets.
An early cold spell caught the village unprepared. The shepherd is making blankets for families near the outer wall.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.cartographer_: Bring the cartographer the requested mapping supplies.
The last expedition returned through a storm with every chart soaked and unreadable. New maps must be prepared quickly.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.cleric_hunt.d: Defeat the creature disturbing the village nights.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.cleric_hunt.s: The cleric hears movement beyond the lantern line each night and fears something unnatural is drawing closer.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.leatherworker: Deliver material for replacement packs and harnesses.
A merchant caravan arrived with torn packs and broken harnesses. The leatherworker has promised repairs before dawn.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.toolsmith_mat: Supply materials for a new set of mining tools.
The miners struck a hard new vein and shattered their remaining tools. Work has stopped until replacements can be forged.
Hunt the beast threatening the food caravans.
Food shipments have vanished along the old road. The butcher believes a dangerous beast has learned to stalk the caravans.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.mason_rebuild: Deliver building materials to the village mason.
Spring floods damaged the village bridge, leaving merchants unable to bring their carts through.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.cleric_nether: Defeat the Nether creature feeding the shrine's corruption.
A sacred flame has turned black. The cleric believes its corruption is being sustained by a creature somewhere in the Nether.
quest.aegis_ascension.side.fisherman_swa: Gather the unusual bait requested by the fisherman.
Something enormous has been pulling beneath the swamp water. The fisherman needs stronger bait before attempting another cast.

perk.aegis_ascension.perk_tsukiyuki_miya:
① Damage bonus +{{damage_bonus:percent}} ② Move speed +{{movement_speed_multiplier:percent}}
Equipment Lightweighting: {{ignore_damage_chance:percent}} chance to ignore damage taken.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_told_you_its_m: Breakthrough can trigger critical strikes. Critical chance is {{breakthrough_critical_chance_per_rank:percent}} per rank and critical damage is fixed at {{fixed_critical_damage:percent}}. Can be acquired up to {{max_rank:number}} times.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_noelle.name: Noelle
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_arona.name: Arona
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_arona.descript:
① Primary Attribute +{{primary_attribute_multiplier:percent}}
② Breakthrough: Gain {{breakthrough_primary_attribute_flat:number}} flat Primary Stat. Critical Chance applies {{primary_stat_multiplier_critical_chance:percent}} of this gain; other Primary Attributes use {{primary_stat_multiplier_default:percent}}. The multiplier follows your current Primary Attribute and is recalculated whenever you switch it.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_matter_to_magi: Unlocks Primary Skill Enhancement conversion. In Talent Collection, your locked Primary Stat can be switched freely to any Skill Enhancement stat.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_mysterious_dol: Upon obtaining, draw one available reward from this weighted pool:
Banned or unavailable outcomes are removed and the remaining weights are normalized.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_magic_conversi:
① When dealing damage, increase Maximum Mana by {{max_mana_flat_per_damage:number}}, up to {{max_trigger_count:number}} trigger(s).  
② Increase Maximum Health by {{max_health_per_max_mana:percent}} of Maximum Mana.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_kokona.name: Kokona
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_kokona.descrip: For each owned talent, increase Final Damage by {{final_damage_per_owned_talent:percent}}.
Every time you purchase a talent, there is a {{additional_random_talent_chance:percent}} chance to gain additional random talents. Reward-count odds: 1 talent {{additional_random_one_talent_weight:percent}}, 2 talents {{additional_random_two_talents_weight:percent}}, 3 talents {{additional_random_three_talents_weight:percent}}. Rarity odds per talent: R {{additional_random_r_weight:percent}}, SR {{additional_random_sr_weight:percent}}, SSR {{additional_random_ssr_weight:percent}}.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_magic_blade.de:
① Each basic attack restores {{max_mana_restore_per_attack:percent}} of Maximum Mana ({{restore_cooldown_seconds:number}}s cooldown).  
② Basic attacks deal magic damage equal to {{magic_damage_per_max_mana:percent}} of Maximum Mana instead of Attack damage.
The changed damage still counts as basic attack damage.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_barrage_contro: Barrage damage becomes (base damage + Primary Attribute) × {{barrage_damage_multiplier:number}}. Each barrage has a {{primary_attribute_gain_chance_per_barrage:percent}} chance to permanently increase Primary Attribute by {{primary_attribute_flat_per_trigger:number}}.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_momo.name: Momoi
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_momo.descripti: After Lucky Strike exceeds {{lucky_strike_threshold:percent}}, every {{lucky_strike_overflow_step:percent}} above it increases Final Damage by {{final_damage_per_step:percent}}.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_midori.name: Midori
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_midori.descrip: For every {{final_damage_step:percent}} Final Damage, Lucky Strike increases by {{lucky_strike_per_step:percent}}.
Breakthrough: Maximum Health +{{breakthrough_max_health_multiplier:percent}}, Physical Damage Amplification +{{breakthrough_physical_damage_amplification:percent}}, and Magic Damage Amplification +{{breakthrough_magic_damage_amplification:percent}}. Unlocks Yuzusoft Fan Level at Rank 1 and adds the other Ciallo talents to the pool.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_yoshino_ciallo: Breakthrough: Attack Damage +{{breakthrough_attack_multiplier:percent}}. Increases Yuzusoft Fan Level by 1 rank.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_shizuru_ciallo: Breakthrough: Final Damage +{{breakthrough_final_damage:percent}}. Increases Yuzusoft Fan Level by 1 rank.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_ningning_ciall: Breakthrough: Cooldown Reduction +{{breakthrough_cooldown_reduction:percent}}. Increases Yuzusoft Fan Level by 1 rank.
Breakthrough: Luck +{{breakthrough_luck_flat:number}}. This gain ignores Breakthrough Effect and Starlight. Increases Yuzusoft Fan Level by 1 rank.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_enigma.name: Life Is a Gamble
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_enigma.descrip: Each Breakthrough has a {{enigma_trigger_chance:percent}} chance to multiply its multiplier-based benefits by {{enigma_trigger_multiplier:number}}×; otherwise they are multiplied by {{enigma_failure_multiplier:number}}×. This multiplies with Starlight's result. Bliss Aegis guarantees activation.

perk.aegis_ascension.perk_master_spark.d:
① Move speed +{{movement_speed_multiplier:percent}}
② Breakthrough: shared True Damage +{{breakthrough_true_damage:percent}}. This increases True Damage but does not enable conversion by itself.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_beater.name: Beater
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_beater.descrip: Max health +{{max_health_multiplier:percent}}, Damage Reduction +{{damage_reduction:percent}}, Physical Amplification +{{physical_damage_amplification:percent}}, Magic Amplification +{{magic_damage_amplification:percent}}, Attack Speed +{{attack_speed_flat:number}}.

perk.aegis_ascension.perk_collector.name: Collector
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_collector.desc: Each active Soul Link increases Physical Amplification by {{physical_damage_amplification_per_soul_link:percent}} and Magic Amplification by {{magic_damage_amplification_per_soul_link:percent}}.
perk.aegis_ascension.perk_flower_fairy.d: Talent options {{talent_option_bonus:number}}. Breakthrough: Gain {{breakthrough_skill_enhancement_charges:number}} Skill Enhancement charges. This reward is not affected by Breakthrough Effect.

 - Multi Target Barrage: All Skill Enhancement Attribute +{{multi_barrage_all_skill_enhancement_attribute_stat_bonus:percent}}, up to {{multi_target_bonus_max_trigger_count:number}} trigger(s)
 - Fire Barrage: Critical Damage +{{fire_barrage_critical_damage_stat_bonus:percent}}, up to {{fire_bonus_max_trigger_count:number}} trigger(s)
 - Phoenix Barrage: Damage Bonus +{{phoenix_barrage_damage_boost_stat_bonus:percent}}, up to {{phoenix_bonus_max_trigger_count:number}} trigger(s)
 - Armor Shred Barrage: Lucky Strike +{{armor_shred_luck_strike_stat_bonus:percent}}, up to {{armor_shred_bonus_max_trigger_count:number}} trigger(s).
